title: Shaadi season survival guide by mizaj
caption:
Four functions this week? Your mizaj needs a strategy.

Shaadi season means late dinners, cold halls, rich food and very little sleep. Unani tradition suggests each mizaj handles it differently, from the Safravi who must eat before leaving home to the Balghami who needs a shawl and a rest day.

Traditional wellness wisdom, not medical advice.

How many functions do you have this month?
